Dear Solanteq Team,

I am writing to apply for the Google Ads Specialist position. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to optimize your paid search campaigns and drive relevant B2B leads.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content strategy, while tracking performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, implementing structured data and technical audits to improve search visibility. My analytical mindset and ability to quickly grasp new products and markets make me well-suited for the fintech and payment technology space.

I am eager to bring my skills in campaign optimization, conversion tracking, and data-driven decision-making to Solanteq. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your lead generation goals.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Google Ads Specialist position at Solanteq. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and analytics, and a passion for data-driven optimization, I am confident in my ability to analyze and improve your existing Google Ads activity to generate high-quality B2B leads.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience managing on-page SEO, conducting keyword research, and creating targeted content that drives organic traffic. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads to track performance and guide optimization decisions. This experience has honed my ability to identify what works, what doesn't, and where improvements can be made—skills directly applicable to managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns.

I have also built and maintained WordPress websites, implementing structured data and technical SEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This technical background, combined with my analytical mindset, enables me to quickly understand new products, target audiences, and complex industries like fintech and payment technology.

I am particularly drawn to Solanteq's focus on B2B fintech and payment solutions. I am eager to apply my skills in keyword research, campaign structuring, bidding strategies, and conversion tracking to develop effective campaigns that align with your lead generation goals. I am also committed to staying up to date with Google Ads best practices and leveraging GA4 and Google Tag Manager for accurate tracking and insights.

I am a quick learner, independent problem-solver, and effective communicator, comfortable working with performance data and translating insights into actionable recommendations. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Solanteq's success and would welcome the chance to discuss how my background aligns with your needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of working with your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
